text:
Type: drum shade floor lamp
Use: ambient light beside a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: white fabric drum shade, brushed stainless steel stem and flat round base
Colors: white, brushed silver
Shape: large cylindrical drum shade on a very slim straight stem, thin flat disc base, clean and tall, light visual weight
Feel: calm, elegant, soft, refined
Goes with: grey or beige upholstery, light or dark wood, white walls, silver accents; minimalist or contemporary living rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb GU10 400 lumen. View more product information The textile shade provides a diffused and decorative light.
